$comment: DEPRECATED. VibeHive migrated from OAuth 2.0 Code+PKCE to Google Identity Services (GIS), mirroring the ta-society-helpdesk pattern. The Google Client ID now lives in assets/js/config.js as window.TVH_GOOGLE_CLIENT_ID, loaded via a plain <script> tag before the ES module bundle. See docs/AUTH_SETUP.md for the current one-time setup. This file is kept as a placeholder so external tooling that probes /config/auth.json doesn't 404; it has no runtime effect.
